findings.title: RED root whitespace summary undercounts raw-log exceptions relative to the root's own plan disclosure
findings.evidence: .logs/d110c-0c1f5b-snapshot-fixture-red-03acb4ac/seal-summary.json records rawWhitespaceExceptions: 1 and raw-whitespace.json lists only focused/stderr.log:23, while the plan paragraph 'Snapshot-fixture RED acceptance and retained scope' (docs/production-hardening/production-hardening-tdd-plan-v2.md:104395-104398) records four raw exception locations across focused/stderr.log:23,30, lint/stdout.log:7 and typecheck/stderr.log:22 found by the root's staged diff check. authored-check.mjs only scans .mjs/.md files plus the signed test diff and never enumerates raw logs, so the RED-owner summary was hand-recorded and incomplete. Consequence: a reader relying on the RED root alone gets an incomplete raw-whitespace inventory; the plan disclosure is the accurate record. Raw logs are unmodified vitest/tsc/eslint output, not authored files, so no evidence integrity issue exists.
findings.required_action: Owner: root. Disposition: accepted as already disclosed in the plan; do not mutate the write-once RED root. For future roots, have the sealer enumerate raw-log whitespace exceptions mechanically rather than by hand so seal-summary and the staged-check disclosure agree.

red_causality: RED is genuinely causal. The accepted test (tests/phase-6b-d110c-0c1f5b-snapshot-fixture-contract-red.test.ts, SHA 24b7a57a... consistent across RED test-source.ts, GREEN runtime-roster testHashes and effective-test-fixture-hashes.json) guards typeof bindings.journal.installEpochAnchor === 'function' at line 45 before any call, so absence yields the explicit missing-required-rejection observation rather than an undefined-function exception. RED focused.json shows 1 test, 0 passed, 1 failed, 0 pending, with the sole failure at line 95:92 under token F5B_SNAPSHOT_FIXTURE_SUCCESSOR_INSTALL_REJECTS_WITHOUT_MUTATION; focused/stderr.log shows the expected/received diff (expected asynchronous-rejection with Error('unexpected installEpochAnchor in live snapshot fixture') and isExactError true, received kind missing-required-rejection). No loader, import, or missing-export failure appears. Because Vitest stops at the first failing assertion and the failure is the 16th and final assertion in source-freeze.json's inventory, all 15 preceding controls passed: initial journal/issuance state reads, unchanged input and fixture bytes after the guarded attempt, unchanged journal and issuance state, first installGenesis non-idempotent then idempotent, and one genuine recoverV3LiveReplica returning ok true. RED typecheck.json preserves exactly the three inherited helper diagnostics (TS2741 line 85, TS7006 line 277, TS2322 line 284) with zero new-test diagnostics and matrix pass. tests.patch adds only the new test file; command-status-inventory.json documents expected nonzero statuses (initial format/lint, inherited typecheck, initial readiness overmatch, the RED focused run, and the first validator that wrongly demanded expanded object text from Vitest's abbreviated JSON) with oneRuntimeExecution true and corrected validators exiting zero. The test is byte-identical in GREEN.
scope_assessment: GREEN does only the three authorized changes. Comparing helper-before.ts to the current tests/fixtures/phase-4b-v3/live-snapshot.ts: (1) installEpochAnchor: vi.fn(() => Promise.reject(new Error('unexpected installEpochAnchor in live snapshot fixture'))) at lines 115-117, touching no rows, genesisInstalled, trace, or settlement state; (2) transactWriteSettlementPlan input annotated as Parameters<DurableIssuanceStore['transactWriteSettlementPlan']>[0] at line 271, which matches the published contract in packages/issuance-store/src/types.ts:137-141; (3) a local const nextPlan: SettlementPlan assigned then returned at lines 278-285. The scope check, expectedRevision CAS, revision arithmetic, entry copies, transactIssue plan effects, fakeNetwork, recover, recoverLiveSnapshotPeer, createRecoveryInput, imports and exports are unchanged (equivalence.mjs performs exact-span reversal to the before bytes, emitted-JS reversal, and protected-function text equality; equivalence.json valid). The only cast in the file is the pre-existing 'as unknown as DRPNetworkNode' in fakeNetwork; no eslint-disable, ts-ignore, ts-expect-error, blanket cast, or nullable suppression was added. source-commit used git commit -S --only on the helper with a 1 file, +7/-3 stat. custody-final.json ownerHashes for the eight pending production owners are unchanged and packages/node/src/v3-live.ts hash 389f6d91... equals equivalence.json productionSha256. The mock rejects rather than forging successor state; DurableLiveJournalStore.installEpochAnchor (packages/live-journal/src/types.ts:140) is satisfied by a rejecting Promise without any new API or authority.
evidence_assessment: Evidence is adequate for this bounded batch. GREEN main and isolated result.json files each report focused 1/1 and retained 118/118 with numFailedTests 0, numPendingTests 0, numTodoTests 0, numFailedTestSuites 0; validate-focused and validate-retained stdout in both environments report valid true with exactNames and exactFiles true; seal-summary.json shows all four runners exit 0 and quiescent, 48 command statuses all zero. typecheck.json and isolated/typecheck.json have zero target and external diagnostics; typecheck-matrix.json valid with threeInheritedErrorsCleared true for the selected parent two-root program plus the new test (not a whole-repository typecheck). Isolated checkout.json pins source 2f09a52c plus overlay SHA 6d0fd99c... with noSharedNodeModulesOrDist true; install was pnpm install --offline --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts; native-artifacts.json records fromFreshDownload and noSharedNativeBinary; custody-prepared.json shows compiledInitiallyAbsent true and custody-after.json shows the seven built hashes (for example packages/node/dist/src/v3-live.js f961b541...) equal to main's custody-final.json built hashes. graph-comparison.json: 913 main vs 532 isolated sources, 532 common, isolatedOnlySources [], sharedDifferences [], allMainOnlyAreAncestorAmbientDeclarations true; whole ambient graphs are correctly not claimed identical. effective-test-fixture-hashes.json has 95 entries, which with 8 owners gives the 103 identities. RED manifest has 115 lines and GREEN manifest 262 lines, both self-excluding; helper-after.ts and helper-final.ts share hash fddfff2b... in the GREEN manifest. Review-root custody.json records head 248f40d0, source 2f09a52c, originExact true, and the GREEN manifest SHA ffc0675b.... Coverage boundary inspected explicitly: the import search finds exactly seven direct recovery consumers (e5-01, phase-4a, phase-4b composition, phase-4c snapshot-pull, phase-4c transfer composition, latched-acl referee successor, 0c1f4 bootstrap-policy), five fakeNetwork-only importers (0c1f5b0u room-runtime, 6a successor-activation, 0c1f5b integration 64-writer parent, 6a successor-handle-identity, 0c1f5b0u successor-replay), the node-settlement-contract fixture with its four importers (0c1f5b0b node-red, node-corrective-red, 0c1f5b0t settlement-progress-red, 0c1f5b0u store-red), and the shadow driver's dynamic import; no importers exist under packages, examples, or scripts, and the two storage-browser assets matched only the unrelated browser-live-snapshot fixture, which does not import the reviewed helper. All eleven retained files ran. tests/phase-4d-shadow-comparison-red.test.ts performs a top-level await buildShadowRun() (eager 100-close setup) before its runLivePeerCheckpoint case, so not running it and claiming no runtime credit is correct; shadow-driver.ts hash 3d4bc0ea... is unchanged and runLivePeerCheckpoint calls only recover with genesis material. packages/node/src/v3-live.ts:5531 selects journal.installGenesis when payload.provenance.epoch === 0 and never reads installEpochAnchor on that branch, and the focused test exercises genuine epoch-zero recovery. Limitations: I had no shell, so I did not recompute any SHA-256, verify GPG signatures or origin state, or read the four raw reporter files in full beyond their counters and the validator outputs; I relied on cross-artifact hash consistency and the recorded validators. No wide64, browser, profile, campaign, or whole-parent run was performed or claimed here.
